entry.title: saroo98/cliphistory-android
entry.summary: ClipHistory seamlessly saves the text you copy, so you can find and copy it again later. Works with any keyboard, with one-tap copy from Quick Settings and a super clean, highly customizable design. Passwords auto-delete if you want, and screenshots are blocked. Encrypted, private and 100% offline.
